title: scutellaria pumila
intro: Scutellaria pumila, commonly known as Little Skullcap, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its potential health benefits of reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Scutellaria pumila include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent, which may contribute to its calming and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in Scutellaria pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
